text:
julia_csm: Heads-up — Rainfield renewal. Procurement sent PO with vendor_code RAIN-INT-11 (not in CRM). Requests: Net60, split invoicing US/EU, add 20 seats, keep unit price, move to 12mo. They want PO attached to DocuSign and asked about a 4% prepay discount for 6mo. Any blockers?

mark_ae: On a quick call now. Procurement prefers Net60. I'll try to get single payor; they said they may still route payments separately. PO will be attached to the envelope.

leo_fin: Net60 okay conditionally. Need legal entity names, US EIN and EU VAT, and confirmation which entity accepts liability. Split invoices add ops overhead — Finance may require credit approval or partial prepayment. For prepay discount, need amount and currency.

tara_legal: Amendment preferred for seats + term. DocuSign is fine; wet-sign adds 3-5 business days. Confirm VAT implications for EU split and ensure vendor_code maps to billing entity. If they request DPA/indemnity changes, escalate.

mona_enable: If seats added we can provide a kickoff + 6 enablement hours. Holding a slot tentatively the week after the effective date.

julia_csm: Procurement email excerpt: "VendorCode: RAIN-INT-11; PO# 771122; invoice 70% Rain US (ap@rain.us) / 30% Rain EU (ap-eu@rain.eu); prefer Net60; will sign via DocuSign; may prepay 6mo for 4% discount."

mark_ae: Requested TAX IDs and confirmation of single vs split payor. Pushing for single payor; will update here after call.

leo_fin: Please collect US EIN and EU VAT plus invoice currency. Without that, Finance can't approve Net60 for split invoices.

tara_legal: I'll review the DocuSign draft once AE confirms entity names and attaches PO. If wet-sign required, AE please confirm who will courier and retention plan.

docusign_bot: Draft amendment created (internal): https://docusign.example/envelope/rain-771122 — fields: PO attachment, billing allocation, signer roles.

julia_csm: Marking "vendor_code mismatch" as high risk and "Net60 + split invoices" as medium. Target: send DocuSign within 48h if docs present; +3-5 biz days if wet-sign or credit checks needed. Will update renewal tracker.
